definitions.level: max |corr| of the feature against each of the 43 E14 columns individually -- i.e. against a LEVEL
definitions.contrast: |corr| against home_ewm_margin - away_ewm_margin, a quantity that is not a column in the frame
definitions.partial_given_contrast: |corr| of the residual after regressing both on the frame's margin contrast

verdict: BOTH numbers are real. The 0.636 is a correlation against a single E14 LEVEL and the 0.90+ is against the frame's margin CONTRAST (home_ewm_margin - away_ewm_margin), which is not itself a column. The redundancy claim must be stated against the contrast: at K=10 |r| = 0.890, above 0.8, so elo_diff IS a re-estimate of the margin contrast and not an orthogonal signal. Its residual contribution after the frame's own margin contrast is |r| = 0.000.
